# Sreenidhi Food Systems

> Sreenidhi Food Systems is an India-based B2B food-ingredient distributor and application-support company helping food manufacturers and commercial food businesses address shelf life, microbial spoilage, oxidation, rancidity, texture, processing, aroma, sugar reduction, fibre enrichment and frying-oil performance.

Canonical website: https://sreenidhifoodsystems.com/
Contact: sreenidhienterpriseshyd@gmail.com | +91 74166 25616

## Segments served

- [Bakery](https://sreenidhifoodsystems.com/segments/bakery.html): Find preservatives, antioxidants, improvers, vanilla, sugar-reduction and fibre solutions for bread, cakes, muffins, biscuits, cookies, rusks and khari.
- [Sweets](https://sreenidhifoodsystems.com/segments/sweets.html): Explore shelf-life preservatives, frying-oil systems, sugar replacement and fibre solutions for ladoo, peda, burfi, halwa and packaged Indian sweets.
- [Snacks & Namkeen](https://sreenidhifoodsystems.com/segments/snacks-namkeen.html): Improve namkeen and snack shelf life, rancidity control, crispness, oil pickup, frying-oil condition and seasoning stability.
- [Millet, Nutri & Health Products](https://sreenidhifoodsystems.com/segments/millet-nutri-health.html): Clean-label antioxidant, natural sugar-replacement and wheat-fibre solutions for millet foods, nutrition bars, protein bars, granola and health products.
- [Ready-to-Cook Chapatis, Parotas & Puris](https://sreenidhifoodsystems.com/segments/ready-to-cook-convenience-foods.html): Increase shelf life and help ready-to-cook chapatis, parotas and puris retain softness, flexibility, moisture and freshness for longer.
- [Hotels & HoReCa](https://sreenidhifoodsystems.com/segments/hotels-horeca.html): Solutions for commercial frying-oil treatment and filtration plus shelf-life support for curries, gravies and chutneys in hotels, restaurants and caterers.

## Solution families

- [Antimicrobial Systems](https://sreenidhifoodsystems.com/solutions/antimicrobial-systems.html): Shelf-life preservatives and antimicrobial systems for bakery, bread, cakes, mithai, milk sweets, curries, gravies, chutneys and beverages.
- [Antioxidant Systems](https://sreenidhifoodsystems.com/solutions/antioxidant-systems.html): Control oxidation and rancidity in biscuits, cookies, frying oils, snacks, fats and dry foods with application-specific antioxidant systems.
- [Natural Antioxidants](https://sreenidhifoodsystems.com/solutions/natural-antioxidants.html): Rosemary- and tocopherol-based natural antioxidant solutions for food shelf life, frying oils, biscuits, snacks, millet and nutrition products.
- [Improvers & Enhancers](https://sreenidhifoodsystems.com/solutions/improvers-enhancers.html): Bread, cake, cookie, flatbread and flour improvers for volume, softness, crispness, dough handling, moisture and processing performance.
- [Aroma Ingredients](https://sreenidhifoodsystems.com/solutions/aroma-ingredients.html): Vanilla powders, ethyl vanillin and aroma ingredients for biscuits, cakes, bakery, desserts, chocolate and related food applications.
- [Natural Sugar Replacement](https://sreenidhifoodsystems.com/solutions/natural-sugar-replacement.html): Reduce sugar while supporting sweetness, bulk, moisture, mouthfeel and fibre enrichment in sweets, bakery, millet and health foods.
- [Oil Management & Filtration](https://sreenidhifoodsystems.com/solutions/oil-management-filtration.html): Extend frying-oil performance with antioxidants, treatment powder and reusable hot-oil filtration systems for food manufacturers and HoReCa.
- [Natural Fibers](https://sreenidhifoodsystems.com/solutions/natural-fibers.html): Natural functional fibre solutions for water binding, moisture retention, texture, structure and fibre enrichment in food products.

## Products and application pages

- [Ethyl Vanillin Pure](https://sreenidhifoodsystems.com/products/ethyl-vanillin-pure.html): Pure ethyl vanillin for biscuits, chocolate, bakery and food-flavouring applications. Discuss the required flavour strength and manufacturing application with Sreenidhi.
- [Ezential® Bread Improver](https://sreenidhifoodsystems.com/products/ezential-bread-improver.html): Improve bread volume, dough handling, softness and finished-product consistency in commercial bakeries with Ezential Bread Improver.
- [Ezential® Cake Improvers](https://sreenidhifoodsystems.com/products/ezential-cake-improvers.html): Improve cake volume, softness, moisture retention, aeration and structure across commercial cake and muffin production.
- [Ezential® Cookie Enhancers](https://sreenidhifoodsystems.com/products/ezential-cookie-enhancers.html): Improve cookie and biscuit crispness, spread, texture, mouthfeel, volume and appearance with application-specific Ezential Cookie Enhancers.
- [Ezential® Flat Bread Improver](https://sreenidhifoodsystems.com/products/ezential-flat-bread-improver.html): Help ready-to-cook chapatis, parotas and puris stay softer, flexible and fresher for longer with a dedicated flatbread improver.
- [Ezential® Flour Improver](https://sreenidhifoodsystems.com/products/ezential-flour-improver.html): Improve crispness, texture, volume and frying performance while reducing oil pickup across flour-based namkeen and snack applications.
- [FOSLIFE®](https://sreenidhifoodsystems.com/products/foslife.html): Reduce sugar while supporting sweetness, functional bulk, moisture retention, mouthfeel and fibre enrichment in sweets, bakery and health foods.
- [FRYSOL®](https://sreenidhifoodsystems.com/products/frysol.html): Treat used frying oil with FRYSOL to help remove degradation products, improve oil condition and support cleaner commercial frying operations.
- [JELUCEL®](https://sreenidhifoodsystems.com/products/jelucel.html): Add natural wheat fibre for water binding, moisture retention, texture, structure and fibre enrichment across bakery, snacks and food manufacturing.
- [Magic Oil Filters](https://sreenidhifoodsystems.com/products/magic-oil-filters.html): Filter hot frying oil and ghee to remove carbon, food debris and fine particles with reusable Magic Oil Filters for commercial kitchens.
- [NaSure® 19](https://sreenidhifoodsystems.com/products/nasure-19.html): Control oxidation naturally in biscuits, cookies, frying oils, snacks, millet foods and nutrition products with rosemary- and tocopherol-based NaSure 19.
- [NaSure® 37L](https://sreenidhifoodsystems.com/products/nasure-37l.html): Natural water-dispersible antioxidant for water-based and aqueous food systems where oil-soluble antioxidants are difficult to incorporate.
- [NaSure® 70](https://sreenidhifoodsystems.com/products/nasure-70.html): Support colour protection, oxidation control and shelf life in spices, seasoning systems and related dry food applications with NaSure 70.
- [Perfect Vanilla & Aroma Ingredients](https://sreenidhifoodsystems.com/products/perfect-vanilla-and-aroma-ingredients.html): Explore vanilla powders, ethyl vanillin and aroma ingredients for bakery, biscuits, desserts, chocolate and food-manufacturing applications.
- [Perfect Vanilla Classic](https://sreenidhifoodsystems.com/products/perfect-vanilla-classic.html): Classic vanilla powder for cakes, biscuits, bakery products, frozen desserts and food applications requiring a familiar vanilla profile.
- [Perfect Vanilla — Fruit Punch](https://sreenidhifoodsystems.com/products/perfect-vanilla-fruit-punch.html): A distinctive vanilla powder with a fruit note for bakery, desserts and food products requiring a brighter flavour character.
- [Perfect Vanilla — Sweet & Creamy](https://sreenidhifoodsystems.com/products/perfect-vanilla-sweet-and-creamy.html): A sweet and creamy vanilla profile for richer bakery, dessert, chocolate and food-manufacturing applications.
- [Xtendra® 06](https://sreenidhifoodsystems.com/products/xtendra-06.html): Slow frying-oil degradation, improve usable oil life and support consistency during continuous commercial frying with Xtendra 06.
- [Xtendra® 08](https://sreenidhifoodsystems.com/products/xtendra-08.html): Increase the shelf life of biscuits, cookies, rusks, khari and dry bakery products by controlling oxidation and rancidity in fats and oils.
- [Xtendra® Bake Magic Plus](https://sreenidhifoodsystems.com/products/xtendra-bake-magic-plus.html): Control mold, fungal and microbial spoilage in cakes and muffins while maintaining finished-product taste and texture with Bake Magic Plus.
- [Xtendra® Bakers Bread](https://sreenidhifoodsystems.com/products/xtendra-bakers-bread.html): Reduce microbial spoilage and improve the keeping quality of bread, buns and ready-to-cook flatbreads with water-soluble Bakers Bread.
- [Xtendra® CPro](https://sreenidhifoodsystems.com/products/xtendra-cpro.html): Control mold and rope spoilage in bread, buns and bakery products with food-grade calcium propionate for longer shelf life and keeping quality.
- [Xtendra® Dezarto Plus](https://sreenidhifoodsystems.com/products/xtendra-dezarto-plus.html): Control microbial, yeast and mold growth in milk-based sweets and desserts while maintaining texture and sensory quality with Dezarto Plus.
- [Xtendra® Liquid Food Preservative](https://sreenidhifoodsystems.com/products/xtendra-liquid-food-preservative.html): Increase shelf life and control microbial spoilage in curries, gravies, chutneys, sauces, beverages and related liquid or semi-liquid foods.
- [Xtendra® Mithai Magic Plus](https://sreenidhifoodsystems.com/products/xtendra-mithai-magic-plus.html): Control microbial and mold spoilage in ladoo, peda, burfi, halwa and other Indian sweets while maintaining taste and consistency.
- [Xtendra® SPro](https://sreenidhifoodsystems.com/products/xtendra-spro.html): Control mold and fungal growth in cakes and bakery products with sodium propionate formulated to support longer product shelf life.

## Technical guides

- [Understanding Food Shelf Life](https://sreenidhifoodsystems.com/insights/understanding-food-shelf-life.html): A practical guide to increasing food shelf life by identifying microbial spoilage, oxidation, moisture migration, texture change, processing and packaging factors.
- [Oxidation & Rancidity Control](https://sreenidhifoodsystems.com/insights/oxidation-rancidity-control.html): Understand oxidation and rancidity control in fats, frying oils, biscuits, bakery, snacks and dry foods, including natural and conventional antioxidant paths.
- [Frying-Oil Management](https://sreenidhifoodsystems.com/insights/frying-oil-management.html): Learn how frying-oil antioxidants, treatment powder and filtration address different stages of oil degradation in food manufacturing and HoReCa operations.

## Important interpretation note

Product suitability and dosage depend on formulation, process, packaging, storage conditions and the required shelf life. The website supports initial discovery; manufacturers should confirm the application with Sreenidhi and the relevant product specification before use.

- [Xtendra® Mithai Magic](https://sreenidhifoodsystems.com/products/xtendra-mithai-magic.html): Product-name reference for Indian sweets and mithai manufacturers; current enquiries continue to Xtendra® Mithai Magic Plus.
- [Xtendra® Bake Magic](https://sreenidhifoodsystems.com/products/xtendra-bake-magic.html): Product-name reference for cake and muffin manufacturers; current enquiries continue to Xtendra® Bake Magic Plus.
- [Xtendra® Dezarto](https://sreenidhifoodsystems.com/products/xtendra-dezarto.html): Product-name reference for milk-based sweet manufacturers; current enquiries continue to Xtendra® Dezarto Plus.
